evidence: URLs visited, timestamps, typed search terms, downloads, favicon lookups.
tools: DB Browser for SQLite, Chrome History View, autopsy
note: SQLite — check for WAL file (History-wal) for recently-written rows lost on close.

evidence: Session cookies, auth tokens for sites visited.
tools: DB Browser for SQLite, Hindsight, Magnets
note: Encrypted with DPAPI (v10+). Guest/incognito inherits existing cookies until close.

evidence: Saved usernames/passwords for sites (encrypted, AES-256-GCM with DPAPI master key).
note: Requires user DPAPI master key + user's password or domain session.

evidence: Default search engine (evidence of hijack), extensions list, saved password count.
note: JSON — check 'extensions.settings' for rogue extensions and 'default_search_provider'.

evidence: Installed extensions incl. malicious/rogue ones (manifest.json + JS).
note: Correlate extension install time with History + Preferences.

evidence: Cached resources (images, JS, files downloaded to cache).
note: Stores index + f_XXXXXX files; useful when History cleared.

evidence: Site 'localStorage' key-value data, session tokens.
note: May contain JWT/OAuth tokens persisted by web apps.

evidence: Most-visited URLs — survives History clearing in some builds.
Autofill form data (names, emails, addresses typed into forms).
note: Autofill reveals OSINT profiles even when History is cleared.

evidence: Same Chromium artifacts as Chrome: History (Add-Type SQLite), Cookies (Network\Cookies), Login Data.
note: Edge profile path mirrors Chrome; also check 'Default\Preferences' for hijacked search.

evidence: Browsing history (moz_places), bookmarks, visits with timestamps.
note: Also 'places.sqlite-wal'; check 'favicons.sqlite' for icons of visited sites.

evidence: Cookie store (name, value, host, path, expiry).
note: Legacy store; newer versions use cookies.sqlite still, encrypted only with profile password.

evidence: Saved passwords (logins.json encrypted with key4.db master key).
note: Master key in key4.db protected by OS keyring / primary password.

evidence: Restored tabs/windows incl. URLs open at crash/close — recovers cleared-history context.
note: LZ4-compressed; also 'sessionstore-backups' folder keeps older snapshots.

evidence: Cached resources (encrypted with key in key4.db on modern Firefox).
History items + visits with timestamps (visit_count_summary).
note: macOS forensic images — path accessible under /Users/<u>/Library/Safari/.

evidence: Cookie store (binarycookies format).
Most-visited sites.
note: Survives History deletion in older macOS.

evidence: Restored session URLs — recovers tabs after crash.
Executed application evidence incl. browsers and downloaded tools (first-run timestamps).
note: Correlate browser download time with Prefetch of the downloaded binary.

evidence: Network usage per-app (bytes sent/received) — exfil and browser activity volume.
note: Shows per-process network bytes, app connectivity times.

evidence: Recently used apps with last-touch times — browser usage indicators.
Typed search terms incl. filenames of downloaded payloads.
note: Frequently recovers payload filenames users forgot to clear.

evidence: BITS downloads by URL — attacker payload staging via BITSAdmin.
note: Correlate BITS job owner with user and network timeline.

evidence: Recently opened files per-app (incl. browser-downloaded docs and executables), app usage.
note: OpenWith targeted binaries — strong evidence of what was executed.
